starship.notes: Initial baseline: 1.26.0 release notes only. Timezone handling changed; no migration needed for the tracked local %H:%M format. Older releases not reviewed.

tmux.notes: Initial baseline: 3.7 through 3.7c and the 3.7 release notes. No required config changes; copy-mode line numbers are optional. Older releases not reviewed.

helix.notes: Initial baseline: 25.07.1 release notes plus 25.07 upgrade notes. Tracked keymaps do not use changed command-mode syntax. Markdown and extracted HTML/CSS/JSON servers are installed and found by health checks. Selected JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Python, Fish, Bash, Lua, TOML and YAML servers are declared and found by post-apply Helix health checks. These checks confirm executable discovery, not project-level LSP operation. User prefers one server per configured language, selecting the first Helix default: ty for Python, taplo for TOML, yaml-language-server for YAML and vscode-html-language-server for HTML. Markdown intentionally retains marksman, markdown-oxide and harper-ls. Extra Python, TOML and Ansible package declarations were removed. User otherwise prefers Helix defaults; Kotlin default is deprecated upstream and its AUR package requires Java 11. After user installed the rustup component, rust-analyzer --version succeeds (1.88.0). Rustfmt works; lldb-dap is absent. Older releases not reviewed.

hyprland.notes: Initial baseline: v0.56.2 patch notes, with v0.56.0 upgrade notes and v0.56.1 Lua module-loading fixes inspected. Tracked bindings already use Lua. No demonstrated native replacement for monitor-dir.lua; retain it. Older releases not reviewed.

dankmaterialshell.notes: Reviewed v1.6.1 to v1.6.2. Clipboard, display and focused-monitor fixes need no tracked settings migration. User chose to retain nofile.conf at 524288 for both limits; removing it would lower the soft limit to the vendor value of 16384 (vendor hard limit: infinity). Global bar shadows remain disabled by our patch.
